Zero-miss honesty: plugs alone (24 pts, no tie) = 8 missed (worse); busbar tie on the existing 12 guns = 0 missed at 1080.0 kW; 24 pts + tie = 0 missed for 324,000 EUR; 3x450 kW uncapped = 0 missed at 1350.0 kW but the sweep is non-monotonic, so it is shown as a boundary case only.
STATED ASSUMPTION on-slide: a vehicle with two departures on 2026-11-13 is modelled as one overnight energy requirement (S1 24 vehicles / 32 departures; S2 14/18).
F015 (35 min at 50% derate) is not modelled -> ~105 kWh optimistic bias, disclosed.
No post-hoc public-abandonment outcome is claimed for S3: the deck shows the 1,425 kW DC vs 500 kW fallback contrast and that left_queue is 14 of 76 abandoned that queue logic can address.
